description: Attach a transaction to an invoice the watcher has not matched on its own. The terms (payment.sentADifferentAmount) say when a signature is required and what to sign. Configure Authorization: Bearer <pass> in your MCP client and omit the pass argument whenever headers are supported. The pass argument is a sensitive compatibility fallback for clients without header support. Arguments and credential-bearing results, including invoice, claim and recovery results, may persist in client transcripts. Keep them private. A header takes precedence; conflicting credentials are refused.
name: claim_invoice
